prompt.english:
Common cattle diseases:

- East Coast Fever: high fever, swollen lymph nodes. Dip every 2 weeks.
- Foot & Mouth: blisters on hooves/mouth. Isolate & call vet immediately.
- Lumpy Skin: nodules on skin, fever. Vaccinate annually.

For emergencies, call your nearest government vet.
prompt.runyankole:
[RUN] Endwara z'ente ezaansi:

- East Coast Fever: omuriro munonga, amatakara okurebuka. Faya buri wiiki 2.
- FMD: ebisebe ku maguru/omu kanwa. Teeka hamwe ubaze omusawo ahakahaka.
- Lumpy Skin: amatakara ku ruhu. Fayo entulo buri mwaka.

Omu nsonga ya ngirigata, baza omusawo w'endiija.

prompt.english:
Cattle nutrition basics:

- Provide quality pasture grass daily
- Supplement with mineral licks (salt blocks)
- Dairy cows need extra protein: cotton seed cake or sunflower cake
- Calves: start creep feed from 2 weeks old
- Always provide clean, fresh water

Underweight cattle: consult your extension officer.
prompt.runyankole:

- Sha ebitsi ebya mwaro buri eizooba
- Ogunga amayu g'emicungwa
- Ente z'amata: sha obuzibu bw'ebyambu (cotton cake)
- Ebyana: tandika okulisha obu biri mu wiiki 2
- Sha amazi maaryo buhorobuhoro

Ente z'obutungu: baza omukozi w'obukulisi.

prompt.english:
Cattle breeding tips:

- Best breeding age: 2-3 years old
- Signs of heat: restlessness, mounting others, clear discharge
- Heat cycle: every 21 days, active for 18 hours
- Artificial Insemination (AI): available at the district vet office
- Gestation period: 9 months

For AI services, contact your district livestock officer.

- AI: erikubonereka ku kyanya ky'omusawo w'ente gy'orurembo
- Okuzaana: emyezi 9

prompt.english:
Common poultry diseases:

- Newcastle: gasping, twisted neck, sudden deaths. Vaccinate ALL birds immediately.
- Gumboro (IBD): depression, white/bloody diarrhoea. No cure — prevent with vaccine.
- Fowl Typhoid: greenish droppings, sudden deaths. Use antibiotics + strict biosecurity.

Isolate sick birds immediately. Quarantine new birds for 2 weeks.
prompt.runyankole:
[RUN] Endwara z'enkooko:

- Newcastle: okugaspa, ensingo zigosanye, okufa ahakahaka. Fayo entulo enkooko zonna.
- Gumboro: okubijirwa, amasiga maweru/amarukutu. Gwira fayo.
- Fowl Typhoid: ebiturire ebyorobu. Sha eddagala + teera obuzima.

Teeka enkooko eziruha hamwe ahakahaka.

prompt.english:
Poultry nutrition by stage:

- Chicks (0-8 wks): chick starter mash, 22% protein
- Growers (8-20 wks): grower mash, 18% protein
- Layers (20+ wks): layer mash + calcium (eggshells or limestone)
- Local breeds: supplement maize bran with insects, fishmeal, or soya

Always provide clean water. Wet or mouldy feed causes disease.
prompt.runyankole:
[RUN] Okulisha enkooko:

- Ebyana (0-8 wiiki): okulisha kw'ebyana, protein 22%
- Ezikura (8-20 wiiki): okulisha kw'ezikura, protein 18%
- Ezitagya amaai: layer mash + calcium
- Endaro z'omu nsi: ogunga ebitsi eby'ebyambu (endiga, enka y'enyanja)

Sha amazi maaryo. Okulisha okwibuha kureetera endwara.

prompt.english:
Common pig diseases:

- African Swine Fever (ASF): high fever, red/purple skin blotches. REPORT to authorities immediately — no cure, highly contagious.
- PRRS: reproductive failures, breathing problems. Vaccinate.
- Intestinal worms: poor growth, rough coat. Deworm every 3 months.

Never feed pigs raw meat, blood, or uncooked kitchen scraps.
prompt.runyankole:
[RUN] Endwara z'embizzi:

- African Swine Fever: omuriro munonga, enhumuro ya ruhu. BWATIKA ba ndiija AHAKAHAKA — ntakura kugya.
- PRRS: okwita amahanga, okuhuumura. Fayo entulo.
- Endiga: okukura kubi. Kura buri myezi 3.

Otataha embizzi enyama kamu oba okulisha okutahaikiriizibwa.

prompt.english:
Pig nutrition basics:

- Feed twice daily: morning and evening
- Good diet: maize bran, cassava, sweet potato vines, cooked kitchen scraps
- Sows in late pregnancy: increase feed by 50%
- Provide clean water — pigs drink 5-10 litres daily
- Avoid: raw meat, mouldy feed, excess salt

Underweight pigs likely have worms — deworm before adjusting diet.
prompt.runyankole:
[RUN] Okulisha embizzi:

- Sha ebyokulya emirundi ebiri buri eizooba: ku makya no kumaryenga
- Okulisha okwekunda: obutunda bw'ebigimbi, manioka, amashami g'amatembe
- Embizzi ezitaana: yongera okulisha 50%
- Sha amazi maaryo — embizzi zimwa 5-10L buri eizooba
- Otarisha: enyama kamu, okulisha kwonona, omucwa munonga
